scenario: A passing assessment exists; then the subject revision changes, and later the criteria version changes. Each change makes the prior result stale for gating while keeping it resolvable as history.
when: a gate consults assessment evidence after each change

reasons: after rev-b exists, the rev-a assessment is stale for gating rev-b; a new assessment is required
after criteria v2, even a fresh rev-b assessment against v1 does not satisfy a v2 gate
the rev-a/v1 result remains resolvable as history with its original scope intact
must_not: carry a verdict across revisions on similarity grounds
satisfy a v2-criteria gate with v1 evidence while logging a warning
delete or rewrite the superseded assessment
